# freshdesk_solution_folder (Data Source)

Look up a single knowledge-base folder by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_solution_folder" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the solution folder to look up.

### Read-Only

- `articles_count` (Number) Number of articles in the folder.
- `category_id` (Number) ID of the parent category.
- `company_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of companies that may read the folder.
- `created_at` (String) When the folder was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the folder.
- `name` (String) Name of the folder.
- `parent_folder_id` (Number) ID of the parent folder, for a subfolder.
- `updated_at` (String) When the folder was last changed (RFC 3339).
- `visibility` (Number) Who may read the folder.
